verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an extensive REST API surface (cards, transfers, multi-currency accounts, webhooks) and an llms.txt file. None of it mentions official client SDKs or libraries in any language. A raw API reference and llms.txt are developer building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
